messages:
maya: FYI toolbar chips overflow in Console is pushing table controls below the fold at 1280x720. screenshot: https://redwood.design/shot/toolbar-overflow.png

sam: can repro. suspect spacing token rename hit the chip row.

jordan: chips wrap to two lines, action column moves. feels cramped. :grimacing:

maya: repro: dataset view -> 5 filters -> narrow to 1280x720 -> chips wrap -> table actions shift.

sam: proposal: collapse overflow to a +N control that opens a popover listing hidden chips. preserves row height.

jordan: +1 but keyboard users need access; horizontal scroll isn't ideal for a11y.

liam: accessibility: if scrollable, ensure focusable hidden items. aria-hidden on overflow is bad.

eva: product: prefer discoverability. +N popover ok if affordance to add/remove filters stays obvious.

maya: mock in Figma: https://figma.com/redwood/infer/toolbar-overflow-v2. I also tried compact spacing tokens but that reduced button hit area on mobile.

sam: snippet i tested:

```
.chips-row { min-height: 40px; display: flex; gap: var(--space-compact-2); overflow: hidden; }
.chip { flex: 0 1 auto; max-width: 220px; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
```

jordan: reference token alias rather than specific token name to avoid future breakage.

liam: note: interactive controls must keep >=44px visible hit area. token exception required.

eva: decision suggestion: responsive behavior: full chips on large, horizontal scroll on medium, +N popover on small. add token exception for button padding and ensure popover sits above toasts.

maya: agree. also had a bug where toasts covered the +N menu. currently toast z-index 800, popover 750.

sam: fix: bump popover to 900. will add aria-expanded to +N button too.

accessibility-bot: checklist: focus management on open/close, arrow-key nav in popover, screen-reader label for "+N" (e.g., "Show 3 hidden filters"), verify toasts are announced via polite live region.

maya: i'll open a PR with the chips flex-shrink change, responsive breakpoints, token exception for buttons, popover z-index bump, and a11y tweaks. design-bot: snapshot uploaded build 48.

design-bot: design-preview build 48: https://design-preview.redwood/48 14 visual diffs: 2 failed, 14 passed.

sam: review incoming. i'll run visual diffs and perf checks.

eva: accepted for next release once PR addresses aria and hit-target tests. :tada:
